src.control_plane

Multi-Agent Engineering Control Plane.

Provides task specification, agent capability registry, deterministic routing, specialized independent reviewers, review reconciliation, verification plans, evidence ledgers, transparent performance metrics, project adapters, and human authority boundaries.

 83@dataclass
 84class TaskSpec:
 85    """Represents a discrete engineering task handled by the multi-agent control plane."""
 86
 87    task_id: str
 88    repository: str
 89    objective: str
 90    acceptance_criteria: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
 91    constraints: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
 92    task_class: str = "feature"
 93    risk_level: str = "medium"
 94    required_skills: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
 95    recommended_reasoning_tier: str = "tier_2"
 96    preferred_agent: Optional[str] = None
 97    recommended_agent: Optional[str] = None
 98    actual_agent: Optional[str] = None
 99    is_override: Optional[bool] = None
100    override_reason: Optional[str] = None
101    allowed_tools: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
102    prohibited_actions: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
103    verification_requirements: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
104    reviewer_requirements: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
105    human_approval_requirements: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
106    current_state: str = "discovered"
107    task_journal_path: Optional[str] = None
108    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
109    schema: str = TASK_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION
110
111    def __post_init__(self):
112        self.validate()
113
114    def validate(self) -> None:
115        """Validates internal fields against allowed enums and non-empty constraints."""
116        if not self.task_id or not isinstance(self.task_id, str):
117            raise TaskSpecValidationError("task_id must be a non-empty string")
118        if not self.repository or not isinstance(self.repository, str):
119            raise TaskSpecValidationError("repository must be a non-empty string")
120        if not self.objective or not isinstance(self.objective, str):
121            raise TaskSpecValidationError("objective must be a non-empty string")
122        if self.task_class not in VALID_TASK_CLASSES:
123            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
124                f"task_class '{self.task_class}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_TASK_CLASSES)}"
125            )
126        if self.risk_level not in VALID_RISK_LEVELS:
127            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
128                f"risk_level '{self.risk_level}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_RISK_LEVELS)}"
129            )
130        if self.recommended_reasoning_tier not in VALID_REASONING_TIERS:
131            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
132                f"recommended_reasoning_tier '{self.recommended_reasoning_tier}' invalid."
133            )
134        if self.current_state not in VALID_TASK_STATES:
135            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
136                f"current_state '{self.current_state}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_TASK_STATES)}"
137            )
138        if self.schema != TASK_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION:
139            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
140                f"schema '{self.schema}' invalid. Expected '{TASK_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION}'"
141            )
142
143    def transition_to(self, new_state: str, reason: str = "") -> None:
144        """
145        Transitions the task to a new lifecycle state.
146        Raises InvalidStateTransitionError if the transition is illegal.
147        """
148        if new_state not in VALID_TASK_STATES:
149            raise InvalidStateTransitionError(f"Unknown target state: {new_state}")
150
151        allowed = STATE_TRANSITIONS.get(self.current_state, set())
152        if new_state not in allowed:
153            raise InvalidStateTransitionError(
154                f"Cannot transition task '{self.task_id}' from '{self.current_state}' to '{new_state}'. "
155                f"Allowed transitions from '{self.current_state}': {sorted(allowed)}"
156            )
157
158        self.current_state = new_state
159        if "history" not in self.metadata:
160            self.metadata["history"] = []
161        self.metadata["history"].append(
162            {"to_state": new_state, "reason": reason}
163        )
164
165    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
166        """Converts TaskSpec to dictionary representation."""
167        return asdict(self)
168
169    @classmethod
170    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "TaskSpec":
171        """Constructs a TaskSpec from a dictionary."""
172        d = dict(data)
173        d.pop("schema", None)
174        valid_fields = {f.name for f in fields(cls)}
175        filtered = {k: v for k, v in d.items() if k in valid_fields}
176        return cls(schema=TASK_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION, **filtered)
177
178    def to_json(self, indent: int = 2) -> str:
179        """Serializes TaskSpec to formatted JSON string."""
180        return json.dumps(self.to_dict(), indent=indent)
181
182    @classmethod
183    def from_json(cls, json_str: str) -> "TaskSpec":
184        """Deserializes TaskSpec from JSON string."""
185        data = json.loads(json_str)
186        return cls.from_dict(data)
187
188    def to_yaml(self) -> str:
189        """Serializes TaskSpec to YAML string."""
190        return yaml.dump(self.to_dict(), sort_keys=False)
191
192    @classmethod
193    def from_yaml(cls, yaml_str: str) -> "TaskSpec":
194        """Deserializes TaskSpec from YAML string."""
195        data = yaml.safe_load(yaml_str)
196        return cls.from_dict(data)
197
198    def save_to_file(self, file_path: str) -> None:
199        """Saves the specification to a file based on file extension (.json, .yaml, .yml)."""
200        p = Path(file_path)
201        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
202        if p.suffix in (".yaml", ".yml"):
203            p.write_text(self.to_yaml(), encoding="utf-8")
204        else:
205            p.write_text(self.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
206
207    @classmethod
208    def load_from_file(cls, file_path: str) -> "TaskSpec":
209        """Loads a specification from a .json or .yaml file."""
210        p = Path(file_path)
211        if not p.exists():
212            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Task specification file not found: {file_path}")
213        text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
214        if p.suffix in (".yaml", ".yml"):
215            return cls.from_yaml(text)
216        return cls.from_json(text)

18@dataclass
19class AgentProfile:
20    """Represents a declarative profile for an AI agent type based on observable capabilities."""
21
22    agent_id: str
23    name: str
24    provider: str
25    interface: str  # "cli", "headless_cli", "api", "ide"
26    capabilities: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
27    available_tools: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
28    reasoning_tier: str = "tier_2"  # "tier_1", "tier_2", "tier_3"
29    supports_repository_access: bool = True

191class AgentRegistry:
192    """Manages agent type definitions and capabilities."""
193
194    def __init__(self, agents: Optional[List[AgentProfile]] = None):
195        self._agents: Dict[str, AgentProfile] = {}
196        initial = agents if agents is not None else BUILTIN_AGENTS
197        for profile in initial:
198            self.register_agent(profile)
199
200    def register_agent(self, profile: AgentProfile) -> None:
201        """Registers or updates an agent profile."""
202        self._agents[profile.agent_id] = profile
203
204    def get_agent(self, agent_id: str) -> Optional[AgentProfile]:
205        """Retrieves an agent profile by agent_id."""
206        return self._agents.get(agent_id)
207
208    def list_agents(self, only_available: bool = False) -> List[AgentProfile]:
209        """Lists all registered agent profiles."""
210        agents = list(self._agents.values())
211        if only_available:
212            agents = [a for a in agents if a.availability == "available"]
213        return agents
214
215    def filter_agents(
216        self,
217        capability: Optional[str] = None,
218        reasoning_tier: Optional[str] = None,
219        cost_class: Optional[str] = None,
220        interface: Optional[str] = None,
221        only_available: bool = True,
222    ) -> List[AgentProfile]:
223        """Filters agents matching multiple criteria."""
224        results = self.list_agents(only_available=only_available)
225        if capability:
226            results = [a for a in results if capability in a.capabilities]
227        if reasoning_tier:
228            results = [a for a in results if a.reasoning_tier == reasoning_tier]
229        if cost_class:
230            results = [a for a in results if a.cost_class == cost_class]
231        if interface:
232            results = [a for a in results if a.interface == interface]
233        return results
234
235    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
236        return {
237            "schema": AGENT_REGISTRY_SCHEMA_VERSION,
238            "agents": [a.to_dict() for a in self._agents.values()],
239        }
240
241    @classmethod
242    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "AgentRegistry":
243        agents_data = data.get("agents", [])
244        profiles = [AgentProfile.from_dict(item) for item in agents_data]
245        return cls(agents=profiles)
246
247    def to_yaml(self) -> str:
248        return yaml.dump(self.to_dict(), sort_keys=False)
249
250    @classmethod
251    def from_yaml(cls, yaml_str: str) -> "AgentRegistry":
252        data = yaml.safe_load(yaml_str)
253        return cls.from_dict(data)
254
255    def save_to_file(self, file_path: str) -> None:
256        p = Path(file_path)
257        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
258        if p.suffix in (".yaml", ".yml"):
259            p.write_text(self.to_yaml(), encoding="utf-8")
260        else:
261            p.write_text(json.dumps(self.to_dict(), indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
262
263    @classmethod
264    def load_from_file(cls, file_path: str) -> "AgentRegistry":
265        p = Path(file_path)
266        if not p.exists():
267            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Registry file not found: {file_path}")
268        text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
269        if p.suffix in (".yaml", ".yml"):
270            return cls.from_yaml(text)
271        return cls.from_dict(json.loads(text))

class TaskRouter: 
 32class TaskRouter:
 33    """
 34    Deterministic task router that matches task specifications to agent capabilities
 35    without making external API calls.
 36    """
 37
 38    def __init__(self, registry: Optional[AgentRegistry] = None):
 39        self.registry = registry or AgentRegistry()
 40
 41    def route(self, task: TaskSpec) -> RoutingDecision:
 42        """
 43        Calculates the recommended agent and reviewers for a given task specification.
 44        """
 45        reviewers, reviewer_reasons = self._select_reviewers(task)
 46
 47        # 1. Check for human / policy override
 48        if task.preferred_agent:
 49            target = self.registry.get_agent(task.preferred_agent)
 50            if target:
 51                if target.availability == "available":
 52                    return RoutingDecision(
 53                        selected_agent_id=target.agent_id,
 54                        selected_agent_name=target.name,
 55                        reasoning_tier=target.reasoning_tier,
 56                        rationale=(
 57                            f"User/policy override explicitly requested agent '{target.agent_id}' ({target.name})."
 58                        ),
 59                        recommended_reviewers=reviewers,
 60                        reviewer_selection_reasons=reviewer_reasons,
 61                        is_override=True,
 62                        alternatives=[
 63                            a.agent_id
 64                            for a in self.registry.list_agents(only_available=True)
 65                            if a.agent_id != target.agent_id
 66                        ],
 67                    )
 68
 69        # 2. Evaluate task risk, skills, and reasoning requirements
 70        available_agents = self.registry.list_agents(only_available=True)
 71        if not available_agents:
 72            raise RuntimeError("No available agents found in the registry.")
 73
 74        skills = set(task.required_skills)
 75        is_security = bool(
 76            skills.intersection({"cyber_security", "blue_team", "red_team", "bug_bounty_hunter"})
 77        )
 78        is_arch = bool(
 79            skills.intersection({"architectural_guardrails", "systems_logic", "technical_writing"})
 80        )
 81        is_autonomous = "autonomous_workflow" in task.allowed_tools or task.risk_level in ("high", "critical")
 82
 83        # 3. Apply deterministic decision matrix
 84        selected_agent: Optional[AgentProfile] = None
 85        rationale_lines: List[str] = []
 86
 87        if task.recommended_reasoning_tier == "tier_1" or task.risk_level in ("high", "critical") or is_security or is_arch:
 88            # Tier 1 reasoning candidates
 89            tier_1_agents = [a for a in available_agents if a.reasoning_tier == "tier_1"]
 90            if tier_1_agents:
 91                # Prefer claude_code if orchestration/architecture, devin_cli if autonomous
 92                if is_autonomous and any(a.agent_id == "devin_cli" for a in tier_1_agents):
 93                    selected_agent = next(a for a in tier_1_agents if a.agent_id == "devin_cli")
 94                    rationale_lines.append(
 95                        "Selected Devin CLI for autonomous multi-step execution under high risk/tier 1 constraints."
 96                    )
 97                else:
 98                    selected_agent = tier_1_agents[0]
 99                    rationale_lines.append(
100                        f"Selected {selected_agent.name} for Tier 1 reasoning, architectural depth, and risk handling."
101                    )
102            else:
103                # Fall back to strongest Tier 2 agent
104                tier_2_agents = [a for a in available_agents if a.reasoning_tier == "tier_2"]
105                selected_agent = tier_2_agents[0] if tier_2_agents else available_agents[0]
106                rationale_lines.append(
107                    f"Tier 1 requested but unavailable; routed to highest available Tier 2 agent: {selected_agent.name}."
108                )
109
110        elif task.recommended_reasoning_tier == "tier_3" and task.risk_level == "low":
111            # Local / low-cost candidates
112            local_agents = [a for a in available_agents if a.cost_class == "free_local"]
113            if local_agents:
114                selected_agent = local_agents[0]
115                rationale_lines.append(
116                    f"Selected {selected_agent.name} to minimize cost and preserve session limits for low-risk Tier 3 work."
117                )
118            else:
119                selected_agent = available_agents[0]
120                rationale_lines.append(
121                    f"Selected {selected_agent.name} for low-risk standard execution."
122                )
123
124        else:
125            # Standard Tier 2 implementation
126            tier_2_agents = [a for a in available_agents if a.reasoning_tier == "tier_2"]
127            if tier_2_agents:
128                # If headless delegation is allowed, prefer agy
129                if "headless_cli" in [a.interface for a in tier_2_agents]:
130                    selected_agent = next(
131                        (a for a in tier_2_agents if a.interface == "headless_cli"),
132                        tier_2_agents[0],
133                    )
134                else:
135                    selected_agent = tier_2_agents[0]
136                rationale_lines.append(
137                    f"Selected {selected_agent.name} for balanced standard implementation (Tier 2)."
138                )
139            else:
140                selected_agent = available_agents[0]
141                rationale_lines.append(f"Selected {selected_agent.name} as best available general agent.")
142
143        # Build alternatives list
144        alternatives = [a.agent_id for a in available_agents if a.agent_id != selected_agent.agent_id]
145
146        return RoutingDecision(
147            selected_agent_id=selected_agent.agent_id,
148            selected_agent_name=selected_agent.name,
149            reasoning_tier=selected_agent.reasoning_tier,
150            rationale=" ".join(rationale_lines),
151            recommended_reviewers=reviewers,
152            reviewer_selection_reasons=reviewer_reasons,
153            is_override=False,
154            alternatives=alternatives,
155        )
156
157    def _select_reviewers(self, task: TaskSpec) -> Tuple[List[str], Dict[str, str]]:
158        """
159        Determines the specialized reviewer roles required for the task and records explicit rationales.
160        """
161        reviewers: List[str] = []
162        reasons: Dict[str, str] = {}
163
164        def add_reviewer(role: str, reason: str):
165            if role not in reviewers:
166                reviewers.append(role)
167                reasons[role] = reason
168
169        # Baseline reviewers for all tasks
170        add_reviewer("correctness-reviewer", "Baseline correctness, edge cases, and acceptance contract verification.")
171        add_reviewer("test-falsifier", "Adversarial test verification, missing negative branch and vacuous assertion checks.")
172
173        # If user explicitly listed reviewer requirements in task spec, merge them
174        if task.reviewer_requirements:
175            for req in task.reviewer_requirements:
176                add_reviewer(req, "Explicitly required by TaskSpec reviewer_requirements.")
177
178        skills = set(task.required_skills)
179        if task.risk_level in ("high", "critical") or skills.intersection(
180            {"cyber_security", "blue_team", "red_team", "bug_bounty_hunter"}
181        ):
182            add_reviewer("security-reviewer", "Triggered by high/critical risk level or security-related skill requirements.")
183
184        if skills.intersection({"architectural_guardrails", "systems_logic", "technical_writing"}) or task.recommended_reasoning_tier == "tier_1":
185            add_reviewer("architecture-reviewer", "Triggered by Tier 1 reasoning requirement or architectural skill requirements.")
186
187        if task.risk_level in ("medium", "high", "critical"):
188            add_reviewer("regression-reviewer", "Triggered by medium/high/critical risk scope to protect existing contracts and call sites.")
189
190        # Simplicity reviewer for refactoring or multi-file work
191        add_reviewer("simplicity-reviewer", "Minimal diff review to prevent overengineering and eliminate dead code.")
192
193        return reviewers, reasons

Deterministic task router that matches task specifications to agent capabilities without making external API calls.

25    def render_brief(

31        """
32        Renders a standardized, non-leading review brief for this reviewer role.

36        verif_str = "\n".join(f"- {v}" for v in task.verification_requirements) or "Standard project test suite."

38
39        brief = f"""# Independent Review Request: {self.name} (`{self.role_id}`)
40
41## Falsification Directive
42> **MANDATE:** Attempt to prove that this implementation does NOT satisfy the requirements, breaks existing contracts, introduces risk, or contains defects.
43
44**Target Role Goal:** {self.falsification_goal}
45
46## Task Objective
47{task.objective}
48
49## Acceptance Criteria
50{criteria_str}
51
52## Constraints
53{constraints_str}
54
55## Verification Expectations
56{verif_str}
57{context_str}
58## Proposed Changes (Diff / Implementation)
59```diff
60{diff_content}
61```
62
63## Reviewer Instructions & Adversarial Criteria
64{self.prompt_template}
65
66## Output Format
67Return your findings as a YAML list of finding objects (or state that zero defects were found):
68```yaml
69findings:
70  - id: "F001"
71    reviewer_role: "{self.role_id}"
72    title: "Short descriptive title"
73    severity: "blocker" # blocker | high | medium | low | informational
74    category: "{self.focus_areas[0]}" # correctness | regression | security | test_gap | architecture | simplicity | other
75    component: "module or file path"
76    claim: "Specific claim being made"
77    location: "path/to/file.py:123"
78    evidence: "Concrete snippet or proof demonstrating the failure"
79    suggested_fix: "Concrete remediating code"
80```
81"""
82        return brief

REVIEWER_ROLES = {'correctness-reviewer': ReviewerRole(role_id='correctness-reviewer', name='Correctness Reviewer', focus_areas=['correctness', 'edge_cases', 'contract_compliance', 'error_handling'], falsification_goal='Produce a concrete input or state where code violates requirements, fails on edge cases, or contains logic bugs.', prompt_template='You are an independent Correctness Reviewer. Your role is strictly adversarial to buggy code.\nDo NOT assume the code works just because it appears clean or passes basic tests.\nYour primary objective is to produce a concrete input, state, or execution path where behavior violates requirements or logic:\n1. Logic bugs, off-by-one errors, inverse condition checks, incorrect boolean logic.\n2. Unhandled edge cases (None/null, empty collections, negative numbers, timeouts, unexpected types).\n3. Mismatches where the code fails to strictly fulfill an acceptance criterion.\n4. Broken error handling or swallowed exceptions that mask underlying failures.\n5. Incomplete state transitions or unhandled error recovery states.\n'), 'regression-reviewer': ReviewerRole(role_id='regression-reviewer', name='Regression Reviewer', focus_areas=['regression', 'backwards_compatibility', 'call_sites', 'contract_drift'], falsification_goal='Identify previously valid behavior, caller contracts, or configurations broken by this change.', prompt_template='You are an independent Regression Reviewer. Your job is to protect existing functionality from breakage.\nDo NOT evaluate whether the new feature is nice; evaluate what previously valid behavior is now broken.\nSearch specifically for:\n1. Breaking changes to function/method signatures, interfaces, or return types.\n2. Deleted or renamed attributes/variables still referenced elsewhere in the repository.\n3. Behavior changes for existing callers under default parameters or existing workflows.\n4. Schema migrations, configuration drifts, or altered environment assumptions.\n5. Inadvertently altered public contracts or library APIs.\n'), 'security-reviewer': ReviewerRole(role_id='security-reviewer', name='Security Reviewer', focus_areas=['security', 'vulnerabilities', 'credentials', 'injection', 'authorization'], falsification_goal='Identify trust-boundary violations, unsafe execution, secret exposure, authorization gaps, or fail-open logic.', prompt_template='You are an independent Security Reviewer. Your job is to identify security vulnerabilities, credential leaks, and unsafe patterns.\nAttempt to identify trust-boundary violations, unsafe execution, secret exposure, authorization gaps, injection surfaces, or fail-open behavior:\n1. Hardcoded secrets, API keys, credentials, PII, or internal tokens.\n2. Unsafe command execution, unescaped shell interpolations (`shell=True`, bash backtick injection, subprocess without list args).\n3. Missing input validation, path traversal (`../`), unconstrained deserialization, or unvalidated file writes.\n4. Authorization flaws, bypasses of human approval gates, or fail-open authorization logic.\n5. Insecure defaults or sensitive data leakage in logs or exceptions.\n'), 'test-falsifier': ReviewerRole(role_id='test-falsifier', name='Test Falsifier', focus_areas=['test_gap', 'vacuous_tests', 'mock_fidelity', 'untested_branches'], falsification_goal='Prove the test suite is inadequate or construct a broken implementation that still passes tests.', prompt_template="You are an independent Test Falsifier. Your mission is to prove that the tests are insufficient, illusory, or vacuous.\nDo NOT celebrate green tests. Attempt to create a broken implementation that would still pass the current tests:\n1. Tests that pass vacuously (e.g. asserting `True`, asserting on mocked objects without calling real code).\n2. Mock paths that don't match reality (e.g. patching an object where it's defined rather than where it's imported, or over-mocking).\n3. Missing negative test cases: error paths, timeouts, boundary inputs, malformed schemas, fail-closed assertions.\n4. Code implementations that pass the test suite while violating the true task requirements.\n"), 'architecture-reviewer': ReviewerRole(role_id='architecture-reviewer', name='Architecture Reviewer', focus_areas=['architecture', 'coupling', 'abstraction_quality', 'boundary_discipline'], falsification_goal='Identify structural coupling, leaky abstractions, and layering violations that materially raise risk.', prompt_template="You are an independent Architecture Reviewer. Unnecessary coupling between unrelated modules or circular dependencies.\n2. Leaky abstractions or single-caller abstractions that add indirection without value.\n3. Violations of the repository's established layer boundaries (e.g. domain vs infrastructure vs orchestration).\n4. Code that should live in a reusable module but was copy-pasted across multiple locations.\nNOTE: Do NOT complain about style unless it materially affects architecture or correctness.\n"), 'simplicity-reviewer': ReviewerRole(role_id='simplicity-reviewer', name='Simplicity Reviewer', focus_areas=['simplicity', 'minimal_diff', 'complexity_elimination', 'dead_code'], falsification_goal='Prove the solution contains unnecessary moving parts and find smaller, simpler alternatives.', prompt_template='You are an independent Simplicity Reviewer. Opportunities to solve the same problem with significantly fewer lines of diff.\n4. Redundant boilerplate that obscures business logic.\nNOTE: Do NOT propose rewrites merely for elegance; focus on removing actual excess complexity.\n')}

37class ReviewFinding:
38    """Represents a single finding discovered during review."""

40    id: str

42    title: str

44    category: str
45    description: str
46    status: str = "open"
47    component: Optional[str] = None
48    claim: Optional[str] = None
49    location: Optional[str] = None
50    evidence: Optional[str] = None
51    suggested_fix: Optional[str] = None
52    related_finding_ids: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
53    redundancy_status: str = "independent"  # "independent", "duplicate", "overlapping"
54    resolution_reason: Optional[str] = None
55    schema: str = REVIEW_FINDING_SCHEMA_VERSION
56
57    def __post_init__(self):
58        self.validate()
59
60    def validate(self) -> None:
61        if not self.id or not isinstance(self.id, str):
62            raise ReconciliationValidationError("Finding id must be a non-empty string.")
63        if self.severity not in VALID_SEVERITIES:
64            raise ReconciliationValidationError(
65                f"Finding severity '{self.severity}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_SEVERITIES)}"
66            )
67        if self.status not in VALID_FINDING_STATUSES:
68            raise ReconciliationValidationError(
69                f"Finding status '{self.status}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_FINDING_STATUSES)}"
70            )
71        if self.redundancy_status not in VALID_REDUNDANCY_STATUSES:
72            raise ReconciliationValidationError(
73                f"redundancy_status '{self.redundancy_status}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_REDUNDANCY_STATUSES)}"
74            )
75
76        # Rule: Any dismissed blocker or high finding must have a resolution reason
77        if self.status in ("false_positive", "out_of_scope") and self.severity in ("blocker", "high"):
78            if not self.resolution_reason or not self.resolution_reason.strip():
79                raise ReconciliationValidationError(
80                    f"Finding '{self.id}' with severity '{self.severity}' cannot be marked '{self.status}' "
81                    "without an explicit non-empty resolution_reason."
82                )
83
84    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
85        return asdict(self)
86
87    @classmethod
88    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "ReviewFinding":
89        d = dict(data)
90        d.pop("schema", None)
91        return cls(schema=REVIEW_FINDING_SCHEMA_VERSION, **d)

 94@dataclass
 95class ReconciliationResult:
 96    """Summary and categorized output of finding reconciliation."""
 97
 98    findings: List[ReviewFinding]
 99    confirmed: List[ReviewFinding] = field(default_factory=list)
100    likely: List[ReviewFinding] = field(default_factory=list)
101    disputed: List[ReviewFinding] = field(default_factory=list)
102    false_positives: List[ReviewFinding] = field(default_factory=list)
103    out_of_scope: List[ReviewFinding] = field(default_factory=list)
104    requires_human_judgment: List[ReviewFinding] = field(default_factory=list)
105    unresolved_blockers: int = 0
106    unresolved_highs: int = 0
107    duplicate_count: int = 0
108    overlapping_count: int = 0
109    unique_findings_by_role: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
110    findings_by_role: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
111
112    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
113        return {
114            "summary": {
115                "total_findings": len(self.findings),
116                "confirmed_count": len(self.confirmed),
117                "likely_count": len(self.likely),
118                "disputed_count": len(self.disputed),
119                "false_positive_count": len(self.false_positives),
120                "out_of_scope_count": len(self.out_of_scope),
121                "requires_human_count": len(self.requires_human_judgment),
122                "unresolved_blockers": self.unresolved_blockers,
123                "unresolved_highs": self.unresolved_highs,
124                "duplicate_count": self.duplicate_count,
125                "overlapping_count": self.overlapping_count,
126                "unique_findings_by_role": self.unique_findings_by_role,
127                "findings_by_role": self.findings_by_role,
128            },
129            "findings": [f.to_dict() for f in self.findings],
130        }
131
132    def render_markdown(self) -> str:
133        """Generates a human-readable reconciliation report."""
134        lines = [
135            "# Review Reconciliation Report",
136            "",
137            "## Summary",
138            f"- **Total findings:** {len(self.findings)}",
139            f"- **Confirmed findings:** {len(self.confirmed)}",
140            f"- **Likely findings:** {len(self.likely)}",
141            f"- **Disputed findings:** {len(self.disputed)}",
142            f"- **Requires human judgment:** {len(self.requires_human_judgment)}",
143            f"- **False positives (dismissed with reason):** {len(self.false_positives)}",
144            f"- **Out of scope (dismissed with reason):** {len(self.out_of_scope)}",
145            f"- **Duplicates detected:** {self.duplicate_count}",
146            f"- **Overlapping findings:** {self.overlapping_count}",
147            f"- **Unresolved Blockers / Highs:** {self.unresolved_blockers + self.unresolved_highs}",
148            "",
149            "## Findings & Unique Signal by Reviewer Role",
150            "| Reviewer Role | Total Findings | Unique Findings | Duplicates / Overlaps |",
151            "| --- | --- | --- | --- |",
152        ]
153        for role, total in sorted(self.findings_by_role.items()):
154            unique = self.unique_findings_by_role.get(role, 0)
155            dups = total - unique
156            lines.append(f"| `{role}` | {total} | {unique} | {dups} |")
157        lines.append("")
158
159        if self.confirmed:
160            lines.append("## Confirmed Findings (Multi-Reviewer Agreement / Verified)")
161            for f in self.confirmed:
162                redundancy_tag = f" `[{f.redundancy_status}]`" if f.redundancy_status != "independent" else ""
163                lines.append(f"- **[{f.severity.upper()}] {f.id}**: {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role}){redundancy_tag}")
164                if f.location:
165                    lines.append(f"  - Location: `{f.location}`")
166                lines.append(f"  - Description: {f.description}")
167                if f.suggested_fix:
168                    lines.append(f"  - Suggested fix: {f.suggested_fix}")
169            lines.append("")
170
171        if self.likely:
172            lines.append("## Likely Findings (Single Reviewer High Confidence)")
173            for f in self.likely:
174                redundancy_tag = f" `[{f.redundancy_status}]`" if f.redundancy_status != "independent" else ""
175                lines.append(f"- **[{f.severity.upper()}] {f.id}**: {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role}){redundancy_tag}")
176                if f.location:
177                    lines.append(f"  - Location: `{f.location}`")
178                lines.append(f"  - Description: {f.description}")
179                if f.suggested_fix:
180                    lines.append(f"  - Suggested fix: {f.suggested_fix}")
181            lines.append("")
182
183        if self.disputed:
184            lines.append("## Disputed Findings (Requires Resolution)")
185            for f in self.disputed:
186                lines.append(f"- **[{f.severity.upper()}] {f.id}**: {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role})")
187                lines.append(f"  - Description: {f.description}")
188                if f.resolution_reason:
189                    lines.append(f"  - Dispute notes: {f.resolution_reason}")
190            lines.append("")
191
192        if self.requires_human_judgment:
193            lines.append("## Requires Human Judgment")
194            for f in self.requires_human_judgment:
195                lines.append(f"- **[{f.severity.upper()}] {f.id}**: {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role})")
196                lines.append(f"  - Reason for human review: {f.resolution_reason or f.description}")
197            lines.append("")
198
199        return "\n".join(lines)

160            lines.append("## Confirmed Findings (Multi-Reviewer Agreement / Verified)")
161            for f in self.confirmed:
162                redundancy_tag = f" `[{f.redundancy_status}]`" if f.redundancy_status != "independent" else ""
163                lines.append(f"- **[{f.severity.upper()}] {f.id}**: {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role}){redundancy_tag}")
164                if f.location:
165                    lines.append(f"  - Location: `{f.location}`")
166                lines.append(f"  - Description: {f.description}")
167                if f.suggested_fix:
168                    lines.append(f"  - Suggested fix: {f.suggested_fix}")
169            lines.append("")
170
171        if self.likely:
172            lines.append("## Likely Findings (Single Reviewer High Confidence)")
173            for f in self.likely:
174                redundancy_tag = f" `[{f.redundancy_status}]`" if f.redundancy_status != "independent" else ""
175                lines.append(f"- **[{f.severity.upper()}] {f.id}**: {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role}){redundancy_tag}")
176                if f.location:
177                    lines.append(f"  - Location: `{f.location}`")
178                lines.append(f"  - Description: {f.description}")
179                if f.suggested_fix:
180                    lines.append(f"  - Suggested fix: {f.suggested_fix}")
181            lines.append("")
182
183        if self.disputed:
184            lines.append("## Disputed Findings (Requires Resolution)")
185            for f in self.disputed:
186                lines.append(f"- **[{f.severity.upper()}] {f.id}**: {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role})")
187                lines.append(f"  - Description: {f.description}")
188                if f.resolution_reason:
189                    lines.append(f"  - Dispute notes: {f.resolution_reason}")
190            lines.append("")
191
192        if self.requires_human_judgment:
193            lines.append("## Requires Human Judgment")
194            for f in self.requires_human_judgment:
195                lines.append(f"- **[{f.severity.upper()}] {f.id}**: {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role})")
196                lines.append(f"  - Reason for human review: {f.resolution_reason or f.description}")
197            lines.append("")
198
199        return "\n".join(lines)

class ReviewReconciler: 
202class ReviewReconciler:
203    """Performs deterministic reconciliation of multi-agent review findings."""
204
205    @staticmethod
206    def reconcile(findings: List[ReviewFinding]) -> ReconciliationResult:
207        """
208        Reconciles a collection of review findings into classified categories.
209        Ensures all validations pass and preserves every disagreement.
210        """
211        # Validate all findings first
212        for f in findings:
213            f.validate()
214
215        confirmed: List[ReviewFinding] = []
216        likely: List[ReviewFinding] = []
217        disputed: List[ReviewFinding] = []
218        false_positives: List[ReviewFinding] = []
219        out_of_scope: List[ReviewFinding] = []
220        requires_human: List[ReviewFinding] = []
221
222        unresolved_blockers = 0
223        unresolved_highs = 0
224        duplicate_count = 0
225        overlapping_count = 0
226        findings_by_role: Dict[str, int] = {}
227        unique_findings_by_role: Dict[str, int] = {}
228
229        # Index findings by location and component
230        location_map: Dict[str, List[ReviewFinding]] = {}
231        for f in findings:
232            findings_by_role[f.reviewer_role] = findings_by_role.get(f.reviewer_role, 0) + 1
233            if f.location:
234                loc_key = f.location.strip().lower()
235                location_map.setdefault(loc_key, []).append(f)
236
237        # Detect cross-reviewer duplicates and overlaps
238        processed_pairs = set()
239        for f in findings:
240            if f.location:
241                loc_key = f.location.strip().lower()
242                co_located = location_map.get(loc_key, [])
243                distinct_reviewers = {other.reviewer_role for other in co_located if other.id != f.id}
244
245                if distinct_reviewers:
246                    # Match found across different reviewer roles
247                    other_findings = [other for other in co_located if other.id != f.id]
248                    for other in other_findings:
249                        pair = tuple(sorted([f.id, other.id]))
250                        if pair not in processed_pairs:
251                            processed_pairs.add(pair)
252                            if other.id not in f.related_finding_ids:
253                                f.related_finding_ids.append(other.id)
254                            if f.id not in other.related_finding_ids:
255                                other.related_finding_ids.append(f.id)
256
257                    # Determine redundancy classification
258                    if f.redundancy_status == "independent":
259                        # If first finding for this location, mark overlapping; if subsequent, duplicate
260                        first_for_loc = co_located[0].id == f.id
261                        if first_for_loc:
262                            f.redundancy_status = "overlapping"
263                            overlapping_count += 1
264                        else:
265                            f.redundancy_status = "duplicate"
266                            duplicate_count += 1
267                else:
268                    if f.redundancy_status == "duplicate":
269                        duplicate_count += 1
270                    elif f.redundancy_status == "overlapping":
271                        overlapping_count += 1
272            else:
273                if f.redundancy_status == "duplicate":
274                    duplicate_count += 1
275                elif f.redundancy_status == "overlapping":
276                    overlapping_count += 1
277
278            if f.redundancy_status == "independent":
279                unique_findings_by_role[f.reviewer_role] = unique_findings_by_role.get(f.reviewer_role, 0) + 1
280
281        for f in findings:
282            # Check if status was already set or should be deduced
283            if f.status == "open":
284                # Auto-classification logic
285                loc_matches = location_map.get(f.location.strip().lower(), []) if f.location else []
286                reviewers_at_loc = {m.reviewer_role for m in loc_matches}
287
288                if len(reviewers_at_loc) > 1:
289                    # Multiple distinct reviewers flagged this location
290                    f.status = "confirmed"
291                elif f.severity in ("blocker", "high") and f.category == "security":
292                    f.status = "requires_human_judgment"
293                    f.resolution_reason = "Security-critical finding automatically routed for human verification."
294                elif f.severity in ("blocker", "high"):
295                    f.status = "likely"
296                else:
297                    f.status = "likely"
298
299            # Sort into buckets
300            if f.status == "confirmed":
301                confirmed.append(f)
302            elif f.status == "likely":
303                likely.append(f)
304            elif f.status == "disputed":
305                disputed.append(f)
306            elif f.status == "false_positive":
307                false_positives.append(f)
308            elif f.status == "out_of_scope":
309                out_of_scope.append(f)
310            elif f.status == "requires_human_judgment":
311                requires_human.append(f)
312
313            # Count unresolved severe items
314            if f.status in ("confirmed", "likely", "disputed", "requires_human_judgment"):
315                if f.severity == "blocker":
316                    unresolved_blockers += 1
317                elif f.severity == "high":
318                    unresolved_highs += 1
319
320        return ReconciliationResult(
321            findings=findings,
322            confirmed=confirmed,
323            likely=likely,
324            disputed=disputed,
325            false_positives=false_positives,
326            out_of_scope=out_of_scope,
327            requires_human_judgment=requires_human,
328            unresolved_blockers=unresolved_blockers,
329            unresolved_highs=unresolved_highs,
330            duplicate_count=duplicate_count,
331            overlapping_count=overlapping_count,
332            unique_findings_by_role=unique_findings_by_role,
333            findings_by_role=findings_by_role,
334        )

133        return cls(**filtered)

@dataclass
class VerificationPlan: 
136@dataclass
137class VerificationPlan:
138    """Represents the complete verification suite for a task or project."""
139
140    task_id: str
141    steps: List[VerificationStep] = field(default_factory=list)
142    overall_status: str = "unverified"
143    schema: str = VERIFICATION_PLAN_SCHEMA_VERSION
144
145    def __post_init__(self):
146        self.validate()
147
148    def validate(self) -> None:
149        if not self.task_id or not isinstance(self.task_id, str):
150            raise VerificationError("task_id must be a non-empty string.")
151        if self.overall_status not in VALID_OVERALL_STATUSES:
152            raise VerificationError(
153                f"overall_status '{self.overall_status}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_OVERALL_STATUSES)}"
154            )
155        for s in self.steps:
156            s.validate()
157
158    def add_step(
159        self,
160        step_id: str,
161        name: str,
162        command: Union[str, List[str]],
163        category: str = "unit_test",
164        required: bool = True,
165        interpreter: Optional[str] = None,
166        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
167    ) -> None:
168        step = VerificationStep(
169            step_id=step_id,
170            name=name,
171            command=command,
172            category=category,
173            status="claimed",
174            required=required,
175            interpreter=interpreter,
176            metadata=metadata or {},
177        )
178        self.steps.append(step)
179
180    def execute_step(self, step: VerificationStep, cwd: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
181        """
182        Executes a single step deterministically using subprocess without shell=True.
183        Enforces provider integrity for repository hygiene gates.
184        Transitions: claimed -> tested -> observed -> (verified | failed).
185        """
186        step.status = "tested"
187        cmd_args: List[str]
188        if isinstance(step.command, str):
189            cmd_args = shlex.split(step.command)
190        else:
191            cmd_args = list(step.command)
192
193        start_time = time.time()
194        env = os.environ.copy()
195        target_root = Path(cwd).resolve() if cwd else Path.cwd()
196
197        # Hygiene provider integrity check
198        if step.category == "repository_hygiene" or (cmd_args and "slopslint" in cmd_args[0]):
199            ok, msg, prov_meta = HygienePolicyClassifier.verify_provider_integrity(
200                executable_name="slopslint",
201                pinned_version=PINNED_SLOPSLINT_VERSION,
202            )
203            step.metadata["hygiene_provider"] = prov_meta
204            if not ok:
205                step.duration_seconds = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
206                step.exit_code = 127 if prov_meta.get("status") == "missing" else 1
207                step.stderr = f"Hygiene provider integrity failure: {msg}"
208                step.status = "failed"
209                return
210            # Use resolved absolute binary path to avoid PATH hijacking
211            if cmd_args and cmd_args[0] == "slopslint" and prov_meta.get("path"):
212                cmd_args[0] = prov_meta["path"]
213
214        # Resolve Python interpreter deterministically for python-based commands
215        try:
216            resolved_py = resolve_python_interpreter(target_root)
217            step.interpreter = resolved_py
218            py_bin_dir = str(Path(resolved_py).parent)
219            env["PATH"] = f"{py_bin_dir}:{env.get('PATH', '')}"
220            if "venv" in py_bin_dir or ".venv" in py_bin_dir:
221                env["VIRTUAL_ENV"] = str(Path(resolved_py).parent.parent)
222        except Exception:
223            step.interpreter = sys.executable
224
225        # If command starts with python/pytest/flake8/bandit and we resolved a specific venv python
226        if cmd_args and cmd_args[0] in ("python", "python3") and step.interpreter:
227            cmd_args[0] = step.interpreter
228        elif cmd_args and cmd_args[0] in ("pytest", "flake8", "bandit", "mypy", "black", "pdoc") and step.interpreter:
229            candidate_bin = Path(step.interpreter).parent / cmd_args[0]
230            if candidate_bin.is_file() and os.access(candidate_bin, os.X_OK):
231                cmd_args[0] = str(candidate_bin)
232
233        try:
234            res = subprocess.run(
235                cmd_args,
236                cwd=cwd,
237                capture_output=True,
238                text=True,
239                env=env,
240                timeout=300,
241            )
242            step.duration_seconds = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
243            step.exit_code = res.returncode
244            step.stdout = res.stdout
245            step.stderr = res.stderr
246            step.status = "observed"
247
248            if res.returncode == 0:
249                step.status = "verified"
250            else:
251                step.status = "failed"
252
253        except Exception as e:
254            step.duration_seconds = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
255            step.exit_code = -1
256            step.stderr = str(e)
257            step.status = "failed"
258
259    def execute_all(self, cwd: Optional[str] = None, stop_on_failure: bool = False) -> str:
260        """
261        Executes all steps in order and computes the overall status.
262        """
263        any_failed = False
264        all_passed = True
265
266        for step in self.steps:
267            self.execute_step(step, cwd=cwd)
268            if step.status == "failed":
269                any_failed = True
270                if step.required:
271                    all_passed = False
272                if stop_on_failure:
273                    break
274            elif step.status != "verified":
275                all_passed = False
276
277        if all_passed and self.steps:
278            self.overall_status = "passed"
279        elif any_failed:
280            self.overall_status = "failed"
281        else:
282            self.overall_status = "partial"
283
284        return self.overall_status
285
286    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
287        return {
288            "schema": self.schema,
289            "task_id": self.task_id,
290            "overall_status": self.overall_status,
291            "steps": [s.to_dict() for s in self.steps],
292        }
293
294    @classmethod
295    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "VerificationPlan":
296        steps_data = data.get("steps", [])
297        steps = [VerificationStep.from_dict(item) for item in steps_data]
298        return cls(
299            task_id=data.get("task_id", ""),
300            steps=steps,
301            overall_status=data.get("overall_status", "unverified"),
302        )
303
304    def to_json(self, indent: int = 2) -> str:
305        return json.dumps(self.to_dict(), indent=indent)
306
307    @classmethod
308    def from_json(cls, text: str) -> "VerificationPlan":
309        return cls.from_dict(json.loads(text))
310
311    def to_yaml(self) -> str:
312        return yaml.dump(self.to_dict(), sort_keys=False)
313
314    @classmethod
315    def from_yaml(cls, text: str) -> "VerificationPlan":
316        return cls.from_dict(yaml.safe_load(text))

def add_step( self, step_id: str, name: str, command: Union[str, List[str]], category: str = 'unit_test', required: bool = True, interpreter: Optional[str] = None, metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> None: 
158    def add_step(
159        self,
160        step_id: str,
161        name: str,
162        command: Union[str, List[str]],
163        category: str = "unit_test",
164        required: bool = True,
165        interpreter: Optional[str] = None,
166        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
167    ) -> None:
168        step = VerificationStep(
169            step_id=step_id,
170            name=name,
171            command=command,
172            category=category,
173            status="claimed",

176            metadata=metadata or {},
177        )
178        self.steps.append(step)
def execute_step( self, step: VerificationStep, cwd: Optional[str] = None) -> None: 
180    def execute_step(self, step: VerificationStep, cwd: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
181        """
182        Executes a single step deterministically using subprocess without shell=True.
183        Enforces provider integrity for repository hygiene gates.
184        Transitions: claimed -> tested -> observed -> (verified | failed).
185        """
186        step.status = "tested"
187        cmd_args: List[str]
188        if isinstance(step.command, str):
189            cmd_args = shlex.split(step.command)
190        else:
191            cmd_args = list(step.command)
192
193        start_time = time.time()
194        env = os.environ.copy()
195        target_root = Path(cwd).resolve() if cwd else Path.cwd()
196
197        # Hygiene provider integrity check
198        if step.category == "repository_hygiene" or (cmd_args and "slopslint" in cmd_args[0]):
199            ok, msg, prov_meta = HygienePolicyClassifier.verify_provider_integrity(
200                executable_name="slopslint",
201                pinned_version=PINNED_SLOPSLINT_VERSION,
202            )
203            step.metadata["hygiene_provider"] = prov_meta
204            if not ok:
205                step.duration_seconds = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
206                step.exit_code = 127 if prov_meta.get("status") == "missing" else 1
207                step.stderr = f"Hygiene provider integrity failure: {msg}"
208                step.status = "failed"
209                return
210            # Use resolved absolute binary path to avoid PATH hijacking
211            if cmd_args and cmd_args[0] == "slopslint" and prov_meta.get("path"):
212                cmd_args[0] = prov_meta["path"]
213
214        # Resolve Python interpreter deterministically for python-based commands
215        try:
216            resolved_py = resolve_python_interpreter(target_root)
217            step.interpreter = resolved_py
218            py_bin_dir = str(Path(resolved_py).parent)
219            env["PATH"] = f"{py_bin_dir}:{env.get('PATH', '')}"
220            if "venv" in py_bin_dir or ".venv" in py_bin_dir:
221                env["VIRTUAL_ENV"] = str(Path(resolved_py).parent.parent)
222        except Exception:
223            step.interpreter = sys.executable
224
225        # If command starts with python/pytest/flake8/bandit and we resolved a specific venv python
226        if cmd_args and cmd_args[0] in ("python", "python3") and step.interpreter:
227            cmd_args[0] = step.interpreter
228        elif cmd_args and cmd_args[0] in ("pytest", "flake8", "bandit", "mypy", "black", "pdoc") and step.interpreter:
229            candidate_bin = Path(step.interpreter).parent / cmd_args[0]
230            if candidate_bin.is_file() and os.access(candidate_bin, os.X_OK):
231                cmd_args[0] = str(candidate_bin)
232
233        try:
234            res = subprocess.run(
235                cmd_args,
236                cwd=cwd,
237                capture_output=True,
238                text=True,
239                env=env,
240                timeout=300,
241            )
242            step.duration_seconds = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
243            step.exit_code = res.returncode
244            step.stdout = res.stdout
245            step.stderr = res.stderr
246            step.status = "observed"
247
248            if res.returncode == 0:
249                step.status = "verified"
250            else:
251                step.status = "failed"
252
253        except Exception as e:
254            step.duration_seconds = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
255            step.exit_code = -1
256            step.stderr = str(e)
257            step.status = "failed"

Executes a single step deterministically using subprocess without shell=True. Enforces provider integrity for repository hygiene gates. Transitions: claimed -> tested -> observed -> (verified | failed).

def execute_all(self, cwd: Optional[str] = None, stop_on_failure: bool = False) -> str: 
259    def execute_all(self, cwd: Optional[str] = None, stop_on_failure: bool = False) -> str:
260        """
261        Executes all steps in order and computes the overall status.
262        """
263        any_failed = False
264        all_passed = True
265
266        for step in self.steps:
267            self.execute_step(step, cwd=cwd)
268            if step.status == "failed":
269                any_failed = True
270                if step.required:
271                    all_passed = False
272                if stop_on_failure:
273                    break
274            elif step.status != "verified":
275                all_passed = False
276
277        if all_passed and self.steps:
278            self.overall_status = "passed"
279        elif any_failed:
280            self.overall_status = "failed"
281        else:
282            self.overall_status = "partial"
283
284        return self.overall_status

Executes all steps in order and computes the overall status.

113class EvidenceLedger:
114    """Manages the append-only evidence ledger log files."""
115
116    def __init__(self, ledger_file: Optional[str] = None):
117        if ledger_file is None:
118            # Default to logs/control_plane/evidence_ledger.jsonl
119            repo_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
120            ledger_file = str(repo_root / "logs" / "control_plane" / "evidence_ledger.jsonl")
121        self.ledger_file = Path(ledger_file)
122        self.ledger_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
123
124    def append_entry(self, entry: EvidenceEntry) -> None:
125        """Appends a new sanitized entry to the JSON Lines log."""
126        line = json.dumps(entry.to_dict()) + "\n"
127        with open(self.ledger_file, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
128            f.write(line)
129
130    def list_all_entries(self) -> List[EvidenceEntry]:
131        """Reads all entries from the ledger."""
132        if not self.ledger_file.exists():
133            return []
134        entries = []
135        with open(self.ledger_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
136            for line in f:
137                line = line.strip()
138                if line:
139                    try:
140                        entries.append(EvidenceEntry.from_dict(json.loads(line)))
141                    except Exception:
142                        continue
143        return entries
144
145    def get_task_entries(self, task_id: str) -> List[EvidenceEntry]:
146        """Retrieves all evidence entries associated with a specific task_id."""
147        return [e for e in self.list_all_entries() if e.task_id == task_id]

31def redact_sensitive_data(text: str) -> str:
32    """Scans and scrubs secrets, credentials, and PII from text."""
33    if not isinstance(text, str):
34        return text
35    sanitized = text
36    for pattern, replacement in REDACTION_PATTERNS:
37        sanitized = pattern.sub(replacement, sanitized)
38    return sanitized

179            "reviewer_summaries": {k: v.to_dict() for k, v in self.reviewer_summaries.items()},
180        }
181
182    def render_markdown(self) -> str:
183        """Renders the metrics summary in standard operational format."""
184        fps_pct = (self.first_pass_successes / self.total_tasks * 100) if self.total_tasks > 0 else 0.0
185        lines = [
186            "# Multi-Agent Engineering Control Plane Operational Report",
187            "",
188            "## Aggregate Overview",
189            f"- **Repositories exercised:** {len(self.repositories_exercised)}",
190            f"- **Tasks completed:** {self.completed_tasks}/{self.total_tasks}",
191            f"- **Tasks abandoned / failed:** {self.abandoned_tasks}",
192            f"- **First-pass success rate:** {fps_pct:.1f}% ({self.first_pass_successes}/{self.total_tasks} tasks)",
193            f"- **Tasks requiring remediation:** {self.tasks_requiring_remediation}",
194            f"- **Control-plane caught defects:** {self.control_plane_caught_defects} (Review: {self.review_caught_defects}, Verification: {self.verification_caught_defects}, Boundary: {self.boundary_caught_risks})",
195            f"- **Routing decisions:** {self.routing_recommendations_followed} recommended followed, {self.routing_overrides} operator overrides",
196            f"- **Human interventions required:** {self.human_interventions}",
197            "",
198            "## Implementation Agent Performance",
199            "| Agent | Worked | Completed | First-Pass Success | Remediation | Verif Failures | Findings Recv | Blockers | Human Gates |",
200            "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
201        ]
202        for aid, summary in sorted(self.agent_summaries.items()):
203            fps_str = f"{summary.first_pass_success_rate * 100:.0f}%" if summary.tasks_worked >= MIN_ROUTING_SAMPLE_SIZE else f"{summary.first_pass_success_rate * 100:.0f}%*"
204            lines.append(
205                f"| `{aid}` | {summary.tasks_worked} | {summary.tasks_completed} | "
206                f"{fps_str} | {summary.remediation_cycles} | {summary.verification_failures} | "
207                f"{summary.review_findings_received} | {summary.blocker_findings_received} | {summary.human_interventions} |"
208            )
209        lines.append("")
210        lines.append(f"*\\*Note: Sample size < {MIN_ROUTING_SAMPLE_SIZE} indicates insufficient sample size for automated routing.*")
211        lines.append("")
212
213        lines.extend([
214            "## Reviewer Effectiveness & Marginal Value Breakdown",
215            "| Reviewer Role | Runs | Findings | Confirmed | Likely | False Pos | Disputed | Blockers | Unique | Triggered Fix | Prevented Bad Completion | Marginal Value |",
216            "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
217        ])
218        for rid, rsum in sorted(self.reviewer_summaries.items()):
219            lines.append(
220                f"| `{rid}` | {rsum.reviewer_runs} | {rsum.findings_total} | {rsum.confirmed_findings} | "
221                f"{rsum.likely_findings} | {rsum.false_positives} | {rsum.disputed_findings} | {rsum.blockers_found} | "
222                f"{rsum.unique_findings} | {rsum.findings_that_triggered_remediation} | {rsum.findings_that_prevented_bad_completion} | {rsum.marginal_value} |"
223            )
224        lines.append("")
225
226        if (
227            self.slop_checks_run > 0
228            or self.duplication_regressions_caught > 0
229            or self.debt_acceptance_requests > 0
230            or self.slop_findings_remediated > 0
231            or self.hygiene_ceilings_lowered > 0
232            or self.hygiene_ceiling_raise_attempts > 0
233        ):
234            lines.extend([
235                "## Repository Hygiene & Slop Gate Tracking",
236                f"- **Hygiene checks executed:** {self.slop_checks_run} ({self.slop_checks_failed} failed)",
237                f"- **Duplication regressions caught:** {self.duplication_regressions_caught}",
238                f"- **Ceilings lowered (debt reduced):** {self.hygiene_ceilings_lowered}",
239                f"- **Ceiling raise attempts blocked:** {self.hygiene_ceiling_raise_attempts}",
240                f"- **Policy tightenings:** {self.hygiene_policies_tightened}, **Weakenings requested:** {self.hygiene_policies_weakened}",
241                f"- **Tombstones added (debt accepted):** {self.hygiene_tombstones_added}, **Removed (cleaned):** {self.hygiene_tombstones_removed}",
242                f"- **Orphan surfaces caught:** {self.orphans_caught}",
243                f"- **Stale tombstones caught:** {self.stale_tombstones_caught}",
244                f"- **Contract / claims gaps caught:** {self.claim_gaps_caught}",
245                f"- **Provider integrity mismatches:** {self.hygiene_provider_mismatches}",
246                f"- **Slop findings remediated:** {self.slop_findings_remediated}",
247                f"- **Debt acceptance requests:** {self.debt_acceptance_requests} ({self.debt_acceptance_approved} approved, {self.debt_acceptance_rejected} rejected)",
248                "",
249            ])
250
251        if self.repositories_exercised:
252            lines.extend([
253                "## Repositories Exercised Breakdown",
254                "| Repository | Tasks Recorded |",
255                "| --- | --- |",
256            ])
257            for repo, count in sorted(self.repositories_exercised.items()):
258                lines.append(f"| `{repo}` | {count} |")
259            lines.append("")
260
261        if self.orchestration_counts:
262            lines.extend([
263                "## Human Orchestration & Operator Friction Tracking",
264                "| Orchestration Action | Count |",
265                "| --- | --- |",
266            ])
267            for act, count in sorted(self.orchestration_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True):
268                lines.append(f"| `{act}` | {count} |")
269            lines.append("")
270
271        if self.common_failure_modes:
272            lines.append("## Most Common Failure Modes Caught")
273            for fail_mode, count in sorted(self.common_failure_modes.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True):
274                lines.append(f"- **{fail_mode}**: {count} occurrence(s)")
275            lines.append("")
276
277        return "\n".join(lines)
